summary: The subject image on the style-transfer endpoint: the picture whose content and composition you want to keep. The look applied to it comes from style_image.
combines: Every side at least 64 px, at most 9,437,184 total pixels, aspect ratio between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1, in jpeg, png or webp.
How much of this image's layout survives is set by composition_fidelity, and how far it may change overall by change_strength.

The AWS mirror gives init_image and style_image word-for-word identical descriptions, both saying 'the subject you wish to restyle'. That is a documentation bug: the endpoint takes one subject and one style source, and init_image is the subject.
range: every side at least 64 px, total pixels at most 9,437,184, aspect ratio between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1
